title: Can and Cannot
introduction: Practise can and cannot with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Use can to say what someone is able to do and cannot to say what they are not able to do.
rules: Use can with the base form of an action word: can swim, can read, can ride.
Use cannot or can't to express inability.
Ask Can you ...? and answer Yes, I can or No, I cannot.

grammar.description: Yes, I can. No, I cannot.

vocabulary.description: Jump lightly or use a skipping rope.
Stop and hold a moving object.
Send something through the air by hand.

examples.question: Complete: A monkey can ___ a tree.
steps: Use the base form of climb.

examples.question: Say that you are able to ride a bicycle.
Say that penguins are not able to fly.
Ask about someone's ability to draw.

exercises.question: A fish can ___ (swim or swims).
exercises.solution: After can, use the base form of the verb.

exercises.question: A penguin ___ fly. (can or cannot)
exercises.solution: Penguins are birds adapted to swimming rather than flying.

exercises.question: I can ___ a picture. (paint or paints)
exercises.solution: Use the base verb after can, without s.

exercises.question: ___ you catch a ball?
exercises.solution: Put can before you to ask about ability.

exercises.question: A horse can ___. (run or runs)
exercises.solution: Use the base form run after can.

exercises.question: Complete: No, I ___. (cannot or does not)
exercises.solution: Use cannot to give a negative reply to a can question.

exercises.question: A butterfly can ___ (fly or flies).
exercises.solution: After can, do not add s to the verb.

exercises.question: She can ___ a bicycle. (ride or rides)
exercises.solution: Use the base form ride after can.

exercises.question: A rabbit can ___. (hop or hops)
exercises.solution: Use the base form hop after can.

exercises.question: Complete: Yes, I ___. (can or am)
exercises.solution: Use can in a positive short reply to a can question.

summary: Use can to say what someone is able to do and cannot to say what they are not able to do.
